meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会当你的写作搭档：帮你研究资料、搭文章大纲、改开头，逐段审读草稿，并按你要求的格式自动补上引文。
howto.when: 当你写博客、深度文章、教程等信息类内容，需要搭大纲、研究资料补引文或逐段改稿时进入。开头会先问你受众、篇幅和风格。

say.text: 帮我就这个主题列一份文章大纲
say.note: 它会先追问受众、篇幅和写作风格

say.text: 这是我的引言，帮我把开头改得更抓人
say.note: 会给分析加几个可选开场写法

say.text: 我刚写完「为什么重要」这一节，帮我审一遍
say.note: 逐节反馈，先说优点再给具体改法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as your writing partner: it researches sources, builds outlines, rewrites hooks, reviews each section, and adds citations in your chosen format.
howto.when_en: Use it when drafting a blog post, deep-dive article, or similar long-form piece and you want outlining, research with citations, or per-section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about [topic].
say_en.note: It asks about audience, length, and tone first.

say_en.text: Here's my introduction—help me make the hook more compelling.
say_en.note: You get an analysis plus alternative openings.

say_en.text: I finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it and give feedback.
say_en.note: Section feedback with specific line edits.
